issues.title: Untranslated and inverted RTL pagination text
issues.description: Pagination controls display untranslated English strings with bi-directional punctuation rendering issues.
issues.evidence: The footer displays '.of 9 row(s) selected 0', 'Page 1 of 2', and 'Rows per page' in an RTL interface.
issues.suggestion: Translate pagination labels to Hebrew and set proper text direction.
issues.triageNote: Real component defects: footer strings were hardcoded English with no override path, and neutral punctuation ('.', '()') inside the RTL paragraph re-ordered the bidi runs ('.of 9 row(s) selected 0'). Fixed with new paginationLabels/labels props (incl. sr-only button labels), dir=ltr isolation for the default English labels, physical→logical margins (-ms-3/ms-auto), and rtl:rotate-180 chevron mirroring; the translated text itself must be supplied by the consumer via the new prop.

issues.title: Pagination overlaps table data
issues.description: Floating pagination control overlaps the final row content instead of rendering in a separate container below the table.
issues.evidence: The floating pill displaying 'Showing 10 of 12 | < 1/2 >' is positioned directly on top of the tenth row, obscuring text in the Merchant and Date columns.
issues.suggestion: Position pagination in a dedicated footer area below the data rows with sufficient vertical spacing.
issues.triageNote: Overlap comes from the eval page's own footer render prop, which deliberately docks an absolutely-positioned pill (absolute inset-x-0 bottom-4 z-10) over the last rows ('pagination pill docks on the blur field'); the built-in DataTablePagination renders in normal flow below the rows and never overlaps.

issues.title: Low contrast account text
issues.description: Account email text uses dark gray tokens with insufficient contrast against the dark background.
issues.evidence: Email addresses in the Account column are dim and hard to distinguish from the row background.
issues.suggestion: Increase font brightness for muted column content to meet standard contrast guidelines.
issues.triageNote: The email cells are styled 'text-xs text-muted-foreground' by the eval page's own column defs (src/app/eval/pair-069 — off-limits), and the token maps to --ds-color-neutral-500 in globals.css (orchestrator-owned); rgb(143 140 132) computes ≈5.9:1 on the dark background (WCAG AA pass), so the perceived dimness is a shared-token / page-styling tradeoff outside this component's editable files.

issues.title: Incomplete pagination controls
issues.description: Pagination footer provides row counts and page size selector but lacks navigation chevrons.
issues.evidence: Footer displays selection text and 'Rows per page 10' without next/previous buttons.
issues.suggestion: Render page navigation arrow buttons inside DataTablePagination.
issues.triageNote: The 8-row single-page table rendered all four chevron buttons disabled at opacity-50 (Button base disabled styles), which read as missing/incomplete controls. Fixed by hiding the nav group when !canPrevious && !canNext so a single-page footer renders as a coherent 'Page 1 of 1' footer; Button disabled styling itself is owned by ui/button.tsx.
